name: Star Destroyer
description:
Star Destroyer kit with an 8 mm flat center strip tapering toward the bow. Its dovetail prevents tower lift; the compact engine-blade tab blocks sliding. The bridge sits ahead of that tab. Assembled: 149.7 x 91.1 x 36.5 mm. Main plate: 148.3 x 202.8 mm; accessory plate: 27.4 x 40.0 mm. Estimated PLA: 16.7 g / 5.6 m.
Use matching version 1.7 hull, engine blade and tower: earlier rail and tab dimensions differ. Upper bridge and shields can be reused unchanged. The unused blade hole is closed.
Print the supplied plates in PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, solid parts. Hull and rail print flat; the flared rail sides are self-supporting. The tower prints inverted, groove upward; the bridge prints shield holes toward the bed and peg upward. Small blind sockets use short bridges. Shields print upright; a brim may help their stems stick. Print two shields if using the individual file.
Assembly: form the upper roof, flat strip and sides, leaving the lower panels open. Slide the tower toward the stern along the rail to its stop. Raise the engine blade from below, seating its compact tab through the strip into the tower pocket. Its bearing shoulders support the strip. Guide the lower-panel slits under the blade hooks, then fit the bridge and shields. To remove the tower, first release and lower the blade, then slide the tower toward the bow.
Cold folding and fit need a test print. Fold once gently; stop if PLA cracks. Do not force joints or scale STLs to change fit. combined.stl is for viewing only.
